4.2K views · 101 reactions | Over 60,000 Nigerians Are Crossing Into Neighbouring Countries To Seek Asylum - Arjun Jain

UNHCR Representative in Nigeria, Arjun Jain, says more than 60,000 Nigerians have crossed into neighbouring countries to seek asylum amid worsening insecurity. He says this adds to an existing population of about 400,000 Nigerian refugees in neighbouring countries, including Benin, Chad, Cameroon and Niger.

Jain says the growing displacement is placing additional pressure on host countries, which are already dealing with limited resources and humanitarian needs.
